title: Constant coefficients and minors from a witnessed quotient-section identity
statement: Let R and A be commutative rings, A an R-algebra, pi in R, rho:A/(pi^4 A) -> R/(pi^4) an R-algebra map, and P a presentation of A with n generators and m relations [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Fix c <= min(n,m) and coefficients b_I in A for c-element subsets I of the generators. Assume rho(P.val_i mod pi^4)=0 for every i and pi equals the sum of b_I times the evaluated Jacobian minors of the initial c relations. Then there are a_j,t in R such that constantCoeff(P.relation_j)=pi^4 a_j for every j and (1-pi^3 t)pi belongs to the ideal of maximal row minors of the n by c constant Jacobian matrix. Polynomial rings and derivatives are as in [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] and [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative].

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CR (lemma-desingularize), proof: choice of presentation through the identity for u pi, before use of Tag 07DQ

proof.text: Compose evaluation with the quotient map and rho. Equality on variables identifies this algebra homomorphism with aeval zero. MvPolynomial.aeval_zero identifies every value with the quotient of the constant coefficient.
Relations evaluate to zero by Presentation.aeval_val_relation. Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem and Ideal.mem_span_singleton give the scalars a_j.

Apply the composite to the supplied minor identity. Use AlgHom.map_det, RingHom.map_det, and the constant-evaluation equality entry by entry. Lift each quotient coefficient using Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective and choose the scalar family d_I.
The quotient of pi minus the sum d_I D_I is zero. Quotient kernel membership and Ideal.mem_span_singleton give pi-sum d_I D_I=pi^4 t. Ring normalization gives (1-pi^3 t)pi=sum d_I D_I.
Every D_I is the transpose of the corresponding row minor, so Matrix.det_transpose identifies it with an ideal generator. Ideal.subset_span, Ideal.mul_mem_left, and Ideal.sum_mem finish.

theorem exists_popescu_translated_presentation_properties
    (R : Type u) (A : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra R A] (π : R)
    (ρ : (A ⧸ Ideal.span {(algebraMap R A π) ^ 4}) →ₐ[R]
      (R ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ 4}))
    (n m c : ℕ) (P : Presentation R A (Fin n) (Fin m)) (hc : c ≤ min n m)
    (b : {I : Finset (Fin n) // I.card = c} → A)
    (hzero : ∀ i, ρ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (P.val i)) = 0)
    (hminor : algebraMap R A π = ∑ I : {I : Finset (Fin n) // I.card = c}, b I *
      Matrix.det (fun j i : Fin c =>
        aeval P.val (pderiv (I.val.orderEmbOfFin I.property i)
          (P.relation (Fin.castLE (le_trans hc (min_le_right n m)) j))))) :
    ∃ (a : Fin m → R) (t : R),
      (∀ j, constantCoeff (P.relation j) = π ^ 4 * a j) ∧
      (1 - π ^ 3 * t) * π ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range
        (fun I : {I : Finset (Fin n) // I.card = c} ↦
          (Matrix.submatrix
            (fun i j ↦ constantCoeff
              (pderiv i (P.relation (Fin.castLE (le_trans hc (min_le_right n m)) j))))
            (I.val.orderEmbOfFin I.property) (fun j ↦ j)).det))
